# DoFlow

> DoFlow is a registry-driven installer (`npx @khoavu882/doflow`) that projects one source of engineering guidance, skills, specialist agents, hooks, and MCP configuration into seven AI coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi Coding Agent, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kiro, and Antigravity CLI. It needs Node.js >=24.22.1; a source checkout runs its TypeScript through Node's type stripping, and the npm package ships JavaScript built by `npm run build:package`.

## Home

- [Home](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/): The problems DoFlow solves for AI coding tools, what it does about each, and where to read more.

## Use DoFlow

- [Setup](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/setup/): Quick start, prerequisites, install scopes, updates, backup, rollback, MCP servers, and per-tool mapping.
- [Guide](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/guide/): Task recipes for features, bugs, code quality, research, docs, follow-ups, the roadmap and other tools.
- [How DoFlow works](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/how-doflow-work/): How DoFlow declares a run, from task classes and gates to readiness, evidence, verification and lifecycle.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/reference/): Lookup for skills, commands, settings keys, storage, hooks, worker support, agents and git intents.
